command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77
echo '=== HARNESS_AIDER_HELP ==='
python3 /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/harness_aider.py --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'
echo '=== PRECISE_AI_WORKERS ==='
ps -eo pid=,comm=,etime=,args= | awk '$2=="claude" || $2=="codex" || $2=="crush" || ($2=="python3" && $0 ~ /harness_(aider|crush)|aider_retry/) {print}' | head -80
echo '=== RECENT_HARNESS_HINTS ==='
find /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/harness-hinweise -maxdepth 2 -type f -name SYSTEM_HINWEIS.md -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | head -8 | cut -d' ' -f2-
echo '=== COORDINATION_PROBE_DONE ==='
